claim: Completion learning no longer treats an ordinary QA revise-and-rerun loop as evidence that a pre-QA proof gate is needed.

checks.summary: The rerun classified TASK-0408 as an approved plan with iterative QA repair and successful completion gates, not avoidable waste.

classification_contract.testability_prerequisite: May justify a readiness improvement when its absence prevented QA from starting and reflects a reusable gap.
classification_contract.qa_owned_evidence: QA collects it or returns revise; its first-pass absence does not justify a pre-QA gate.
classification_contract.delayed_external_fact: Becomes a waiting signal or dated check-in, not QA preflight.
